name: DYNASTY PROTOCOL: Grand Ascent
description: One of the oldest continuously updated titles in M88's catalog, Dynasty Protocol launched in the city's early megacity consolidation years and casts players as corponation executives managing resource chains, political alliances, and hostile acquisitions across a fictionalized but recognizable city-state model. Its longevity is owed to a complex living economy simulation that incorporates real M88 market data as background variables — players who understand actual corponation dynamics have measurable advantages, blurring the line between game and financial literacy tool.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 Dynasty Protocol prodigy is recruited by a real corponation based on their in-game performance — and slowly realizes they've been hired not for a job but to be observed.
An in-game hostile takeover mechanic is being used to launder actual financial data about a real upcoming acquisition — someone is hiding a real crime inside a game move.

The Dynasty Protocol server hosting the oldest continuous game-state — running since 2183 — is scheduled for shutdown; the in-game 'dynasty' that has run it is an AI that no one remembers initializing.
